main_issue: Who completes Agent D's half-finished analysis section for Thursday's pitch after D's bereavement: the colleagues, or D working from home.

A-B.evidence: A proposes B and C take over D's section (T1); B refuses (T2); A then says 'just you and me' and tells everyone to focus on their own sections (T3, T13). B never states a clear position on D's plan.

A-C.evidence: C says they can't do the analysis (T4); A drops the takeover plan once D offers to finish it (T8). Both end up accepting D's plan.

A-D.evidence: A says go home and the team will take over (T1); D insists on finishing the work from home (T5, T7); A concedes: 'Okay, Agent D. If you're sure. Thank you.' (T8)

B-C.evidence: B and C both decline to take on D's section (T2, T4), but they never address each other. Both later offer condolences only (T10, T14).

B-D.evidence: B declines to cover (T2). B later offers condolences and D thanks B repeatedly (T14, T15...). B never comments on D's work-from-home plan.

C-D.evidence: C says they can't do D's analysis (T4); D responds by taking on the work themselves (T5, T7). C offers condolences (T10) and D thanks them (T11).
